name: Agentic SDLC Factory
description: A multi-agent pipeline that turns a written specification or a GitHub issue into tested, reviewed code. Eleven Claude agents share a single state file; a person approves the plan before anything is written, and every gate can block the result.
objectives: Turn a specification into a tested, reviewed application without a developer writing the first draft
Keep a person in control — every plan is approved before code is written, and every gate can block a release
Work on repositories that already exist: read an issue, plan a change, open a pull request
Have the agents verify their own work rather than handing over code nobody has run
